name: Safety margin
what_it_changes: Higher: more parts fail on the solid's margin and fewer struts pass. Set by the part's safety margin (the strength job's loads.safety_margin).

name: Material
section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: Changes stiffness, strength, layer bonding and weight together. Set by the part's material.

name: Cubes along the longest side
what_it_changes: Finer cubes find sharper stress peaks, so margins usually fall. Set by the strength job's resolution.

name: Which way is up on the printer
what_it_changes: Moves which stresses count as pulling the printed layers apart. Set by the part's build direction.

name: Infill of the solid parts
what_it_changes: Below 100 % the solid's margin is reduced. Set by the job's infill (loads.infill_percent).

name: Slicer wall loops
what_it_changes: Nothing today: only read when wall credit is switched on. Set by the job's wall loops (loads.wall_loops).

name: Slicer wall line width
what_it_changes: Nothing today: only read when wall credit is switched on. Set by the job's wall line width.

name: How the supports hold

choices.name: Glued: supports hold in every direction

section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: With bolts, supports let go where the part pulls away from them. Set by the supports' kind (loads.anchor_model).

name: Load scenarios the lattice is checked under
section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: With more scenarios the worst one decides. Set by the lattice's scenarios (lattice.scenarios).

name: Gravity (self-weight jobs only)
section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: Scales the part's own weight when that is the load. Set by the job's gravity (self-weight jobs).

name: Lattice type
what_it_changes: Picks the stiffness table, the density band, the strut rule and the too-few-cells limit. Set by the lattice type in Lattice Setup.

name: Cell size
what_it_changes: With the strut width, sets how dense each cell is. Set by the cell settings in Lattice Setup.

name: Strut width
what_it_changes: Thicker struts: denser, stiffer cells and struts that are less stressed. Set by the strut settings in Lattice Setup.

name: Strength of the plastic
what_it_changes: Every margin rises or falls with it, one for one.

name: Stiffness of the plastic
what_it_changes: Scales solid and lattice stiffness together; stresses barely move unless the supports are springs.

name: Sideways squeeze ratio
what_it_changes: A small change in how stress spreads in solid parts.

name: Weight of the solid plastic
section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: The reported weight, and the load in self-weight jobs.

name: Strength left across printed layers
what_it_changes: The layer margins of the solid and of the struts rise or fall with it, one for one. Per material; above 0 and at most 1 (a share of the plastic's own strength).

name: Lowest safety margin a job may ask for
what_it_changes: The lowest safety margin a strength job may ask for. Lower lets a weaker part pass; raising it above a job's own safety margin refuses that job.

name: How hard low infill is punished
what_it_changes: Bigger: a lower infill cuts the solid's margin more. Only matters below 100 % infill.

name: Smallest infill reduction
what_it_changes: The smallest the infill reduction can be. Only matters at almost no infill.

name: Credit the slicer's solid walls
what_it_changes: On (the default): the solid within the printed wall thickness of a surface counts at full strength, and only the inside takes the infill reduction, so thin solid members at low infill get credit for their walls (wall loops x line width) and margins rise. Off: the whole solid takes the infill reduction.

name: Widest member the width measure looks for
what_it_changes: How far (in cubes) the member-width measure looks: it feeds the too-few-cells flag and, with wall credit on, the walls. Capped at 256 because its cost grows with it (one pass per cube of reach).

name: Which touching cubes count as joined
what_it_changes: Faces only (6) fails parts joined only along an edge or at a corner; 26 counts every touching cube.

name: Density above which a cube is material
what_it_changes: Nothing in this check today: every cube is full or empty. Must stay strictly between 0 and 1 (the analysis refuses anything else).

name: Stiffness left in an empty cube
what_it_changes: Stiffness an empty (no-credit) cube keeps, as a share of solid. Keeps the sums solvable; larger lets empty cubes carry a little load.

name: How exactly the computer solves
what_it_changes: How exactly the solver must solve. Looser: noisier margins, and the re-solve proof's band (100 x this) widens with it.

name: Solver step limit (0 = twice the unknowns)
what_it_changes: The solver's step limit; 0 means twice the number of unknowns. Too few and the check stops with 'did not settle' and no file.

name: Most re-solves to find which bolts press
what_it_changes: Bolts only: the most re-solves to find which bolts press. More settle more often; capped at 60 because each round is a full solve.

name: Most support force allowed in sideways slip
what_it_changes: Bolts only: the most of the support force the near-frictionless sideways springs may carry; over it the part fails whatever its margin.

name: Bolt support stiffness (steel through 1 mm)
what_it_changes: Bolts only: the support stiffness (steel E through 1 mm). Softer supports give more and move the stress.

name: Sideways grip of a pressing bolt
what_it_changes: Bolts only: the sideways grip of a pressing bolt, as a share of its push stiffness. Bigger acts like friction.

name: Stiffness of switched-off supports in a scenario
what_it_changes: Scenarios only: the stiffness of the springs holding a scenario's switched-off supports (share of E x cube size). Too stiff and they carry load.

name: Lowest scale of those springs
what_it_changes: Scenarios only: the lowest scale of those springs. Lower: the solver can stall. At most 1 (the scale of the heaviest scenario).

name: Most of a scenario's load the switched-off supports may carry
what_it_changes: Scenarios only: over this share of a scenario's load carried by its switched-off supports, that scenario has no path and the lattice is not accepted.

name: Allowed size difference between the two copies of the part
section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: Smaller: more checks refused as 'not the same part'.

name: Same, as a share of the part's diagonal
section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: Smaller: more checks refused as 'not the same part'.

name: Cells cut by the surface count as empty
what_it_changes: A ruling, not a number (rules V1, V4): a cut cell is not the cell the stiffness table describes.

name: Cells that lost a bar count as empty
what_it_changes: A ruling, not a number (rules V1, V4): the check never counts a bar the file does not have.

name: Cells outside the measured density range count as empty
what_it_changes: A ruling, not a number (rules V1, V4): outside the measured range there is no stiffness to use.

name: Height match for a bar the file left out
what_it_changes: Fixed: it is the file writer's own rule for leaving a bar out. Changed in the check alone, the check would credit cells whose bars the file does not have (rule V1).

name: Reach match for a bar the file left out
what_it_changes: Fixed: it is the file writer's own rule for leaving a bar out. Changed in the check alone, the check would credit cells whose bars the file does not have (rule V1).

name: Stiffness error accepted from the smeared-lattice model
what_it_changes: Fixed: the too-few-cells limits and the stiffness rows are measured numbers taken at 2.4 %. A different band needs each type's error curve, and core holds only octet's.

name: Struts decide 'accepted' only when no solid carries load
what_it_changes: The ruling of 2026-11-06: the strut margin decides 'accepted' only when no solid carries the load.

name: A pass needs the struts to keep the margin too
what_it_changes: The owner's ruling (V5): in Structural a pass needs the struts to keep the margin too.

name: Densities outside the strut rule's range use its end row
what_it_changes: Fixed: outside the strut rule's measured range the end row is used and counted; guessing beyond the measurements is not allowed.

name: Thin spots before the diagnosis warns
what_it_changes: How many thin spots before the diagnosis warns. Words only; never the verdict.

name: Lightest lattice the stiffness table is trusted for
what_it_changes: Lighter cells get no credit.

name: Densest lattice the stiffness table is trusted for
what_it_changes: Denser cells get no credit.

name: Measured stiffness of each lattice type by density
what_it_changes: How the load splits between lattice and solid.

name: Measured density of a cell from its size and strut width
what_it_changes: Each cell's density.

name: Fewest cells across a member
what_it_changes: Below it the strut numbers are only indicative; with no solid carrying load the lattice is not certified.

name: Measured strut stress per unit of smeared stress
what_it_changes: The struts' margins. Measured: the octet on 2026-11-17 on the full octet (legs and braces, the cell the engine lays; evidence/2026-11-17-octet-full-strut-law), its lowest row (0.04959) inside the lattice only and so a lower bound, which is why an octet cell under 0.10 gets no strut pass; the other eight types on 2026-11-09.

name: Density range each strut rule covers
what_it_changes: Outside it the end row is used and counted. For the octet it is the whole octet band (2026-11-17), so no octet cell is clamped.

name: Allowed difference when the solid is re-solved
what_it_changes: Nothing in the verdict. The result is written as resolve_reproduces, with the two margins compared.

name: Lightest scenario allowed, as a share of the heaviest
section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: Under it the check is refused before it runs.

name: Size of one cube
what_it_changes: Longest side of the part divided by the cubes along it.

name: Stiffness table scaled to the material
what_it_changes: Follows the material's stiffness.

name: Extra layer stress when up is not along a cell edge
what_it_changes: Follows the build direction; 0 when up is along a cell edge.

name: Unit conversion for weight
section: The part, loads, supports and material
what_it_changes: None: a unit conversion.

name: Bar ends that count as one joint
what_it_changes: Bar ends closer than this are one joint of the frame. Larger joins ends that are near but not touching.

name: How near a loose end must be to a strut
what_it_changes: A strut end that stops on another strut is looked for on struts this near. A search distance only; the next setting decides.

name: How exactly a loose end must lie on a strut
what_it_changes: A loose end this close to another strut's line splits that strut there (a T-join). Larger: more T-joins.

name: Shortest piece kept
what_it_changes: A piece of strut shorter than this is left out of the frame (it has no length to bend).

name: How stiff a link is
unit: times a strut of its size
what_it_changes: A link (the short joiner where two strands cross) is a beam of its own size made this many times stiffer, so the two strands move as one. A link is never judged.

name: How far a solid joint looks for the solid's movement
what_it_changes: A joint in the solid moves as the material cubes within this many cubes of it move, on average. Larger: smoother, but further from the joint.

name: How full a cube must be to move a joint
what_it_changes: Only cubes at least this full of material are averaged for a solid joint's movement.

name: How far a solid joint may look for the solid when none is near
what_it_changes: A strut joint the part calls solid but with no full cube near it (it lies just outside the small cubes) looks up to this many cubes away for the solid it moves with; with none, it is left free. Larger: such joints are held by solid further away.

name: When a piece of the frame lies on one line
what_it_changes: A piece of the frame whose joints lie this close to one line cannot be turned about it, so its turning is held.

name: Most solid joints looked at for a straight piece
what_it_changes: A piece of the frame with fewer solid joints than this is tested for lying on one line.

name: How far up a joint on the bed floor reads its movement
what_it_changes: A joint on the solid floor laid on the bed under an Organic region moves as the material this many cubes above it moves. 0 (the prototype's value): at the joint itself.

name: Joints on the bed floor are not held by the solid
what_it_changes: On: a joint on the solid floor laid on the bed is free, as any strut joint. Off (the prototype's default): it moves as the solid round it.

name: Most load allowed on lattice with no strut near
what_it_changes: When more than this share of the load lands on lattice with no strut joint near it, the check fails: the load is on open lattice.

name: Most strut length allowed with no solid joint
what_it_changes: Struts in pieces of the frame that touch no solid cannot be judged; above this share of the length the result is "solid only".

name: Shortest piece that counts for its strut's stress
what_it_changes: A piece of a strut shorter than this times its width does not set the strut's stress (its end forces are not a beam's).

name: Points per cube edge for the material
what_it_changes: Each cube is read at this many points along each edge (this cubed in all) to find how much of it is solid and how much lattice.

name: Stiffness kept by an empty cube
what_it_changes: An empty cube inside the part keeps this share of the plastic's stiffness in the cube model the frame is moved by.

name: Most memory the frame's solve may take
what_it_changes: The frame is solved only when its predicted size is under this; otherwise the result is "solid only".

name: Weakest struts listed
what_it_changes: How many of the weakest struts the result lists, with where they are.

name: Margin below which a strut is strengthened
what_it_changes: Each round strengthens the struts whose margin is under this. Higher: more struts are strengthened.

name: Largest stress boost
what_it_changes: The stress near a weak strut is multiplied by at most this, so the next lay puts more and wider struts there.

name: How sharply the boost grows
what_it_changes: The boost is (watch margin / the strut's margin) to this power. Higher: weak struts get a bigger boost.

name: Margin a widened strut aims for
what_it_changes: A weak strut's place is given a least width of its widest width times this over its margin, so it lands near this margin.

name: Most rounds of strengthening
what_it_changes: How many times the lattice is strengthened and checked again at most. 0: 6 when adding (it stops as soon as nothing is under the safety margin); 2 for Traced, 3 for Grown when laying again.

name: How far round a weak strut a round reaches
what_it_changes: The stress boost and the least width reach this many times the mean spacing in use in the weave round each weak strut. Larger: more of the lattice is changed.

name: How a round strengthens

choices.name: Lay again ("rebuild": a boosted stress, the whole lattice laid again)

what_it_changes: Add: the lattice is laid once and each round only widens weak struts in place and braces those that buckle. Lay again: each round lays the whole lattice again from a boosted stress, so struts move.

name: Widest a strut may be made
what_it_changes: Add mode: a strut is never widened past this many times your widest strut width (your one width when there is no range). Higher: weak struts may grow wider.

name: Widening for a pulled or pushed strut
what_it_changes: Add mode: a strut whose stress is mostly pull or push is widened by (aim / its margin) to one over this. Its strength grows as its width squared, hence 2.

name: Widening for a bent strut
what_it_changes: Add mode: a strut whose stress is mostly bending is widened by (aim / its margin) to one over this. Its bending strength grows as its width cubed, hence 3.

name: Widening for a buckling strut no brace could reach
what_it_changes: Add mode: a strut that buckles and could not be braced is widened by (aim / its margin) to one over this. Its buckling load grows as its width to the fourth, hence 4.

name: Lay new vines where widening is not enough
what_it_changes: Add mode: a weak strut is widened up to the upper strut width (the limit) and no further; if it needs more, it gets a new vine laid beside it along the stress in the same round, joined to the lattice at both ends (a long bent strut gets a brace at its middle first). Only when no vine can be laid (no room, or its vines are all laid and it is still weak) is it widened past the limit, up to the cap, and each such strut is reported. Off: the rounds only widen (up to the cap) and brace, as before.

name: Most new vines in one round
what_it_changes: Add mode: at most this many weak struts get a new vine (or a middle brace) in one round, the weakest first.

name: Least gain that still counts as widening helping
what_it_changes: No longer read (2026-11-19): every weak strut that needs to be wider than the upper strut width now gets a new vine, whether or not widening helped before.

name: Shortest bent strut braced at its middle first
what_it_changes: Add mode: a weak strut that fails mostly by bending and is longer than this gets a brace at its middle before any new vine. Shorter ones get a vine straight away.

name: Longest a new vine may run each way
what_it_changes: Add mode: a new vine that runs further than this each way from its start without meeting the lattice or the solid is not laid.

name: How close in angle a new vine may run beside another
what_it_changes: Add mode: a new vine that runs closer than the gap beside a strut it does not join, within this angle of it, for more than one spacing is not laid (it would fuse with it). Larger: more vines are refused.

name: Most new vines for one strut
what_it_changes: Add mode: a weak strut gets at most this many new vines over the whole strengthening (one a round at most). Once it has them all and is still weak, it is widened past the upper strut width, up to the cap.

name: How far a new vine's end may move to reach a joint
what_it_changes: Add mode: where a new vine meets a strut, its end is moved to the nearest joint of that strut within this many spacings, so it does not land in the middle of the strut and bend it. The move is not made (that vine start is given up) if the moved end would run too close beside another strut or along a strut at the joint. 0: vines end wherever they meet a strut.

name: Most weak areas of the solid listed
what_it_changes: When the solid part does not certify, at most this many of its weak areas are listed and marked, the worst first.

name: How near a fixing, the load or the lattice a weak area is said to be beside it
what_it_changes: A weak area whose worst cube is within this many cubes of a fixing, the load or the lattice is said to be beside it, and its advice says so. Larger: more areas are put down to a fixing, the load or the lattice.
